newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks power higher, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks power higher, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. stocks pushed higher around midday on Friday, as a rallying bond market took some focus away from corporate earnings reports, analysts said.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average, which rose only mildly at the market open, added around 48 points to 7935 as the bond market gathered steam. Nasdaq rose seven points to 1498.
The New York Stock Exchange set curbs on index-arbitrage trading at 1146 EDT/1546 GMT.
The long bond gained 12/32 to yield 6.54 percent, as the release of the June Producer Price Index provided soothing news on the inflation front.
